scope: CPU-only source, receipt, canonical-schema, command-body, native-artifact, and same-body mocked-child review. No GPU, HTTP, service, or compile was started.

positive_v8_evidence.criterion: Full runtime source, V8 runner/parser, and frozen inputs are bound
positive_v8_evidence.evidence: Remote source map matches receipt: parent V8, V8 runner, V7 parser, startup/probe, D07, both inputs, and native provenance are regular non-symlink mode 0444; filedry returns the complete runner source map.

V8 retains the finite/positive two-record parser and applies >30 decode speed to original and exact-[256,256] fixed groups. Independent same-body low-speed mock stopped after group 0 with not_met, calls=[2].

positive_v8_evidence.criterion: D07 birth/scope, paired ports, cleanup, and terminal behavior
positive_v8_evidence.evidence: V8 direct verify_receipt checks published child identity and explicit worktree/output scope; preflight creates output before gates; paired ports are reserved/rechecked; cleanup invokes GPU-idle again and retains lock on post-idle failure. Independent mocks verified bad receipt scope -> failed_harness calls=0, dispatch failure -> failed_harness calls=[2,4], pre-idle -> terminal calls=0, and post-idle -> failed_harness with lock_retained=true.

Producer fields are compatible with D07 process_identity: branch event has pid/start_ticks while D07 supplies matching pid/start_ticks/pgid. V8 checks schema, method, entered, candidate, request count, feature flag, engine birth, engine PGID, and engine-child distinctness. Independent wrong-engine-PID mock became not_met after calls=[2].

Sealed native provenance and reuse receipt match their stated hashes. Source/destination _cpu_moe and _pinned_tensor files are regular files with matching stated SHA/size; candidate kernel-path git diff is empty and tracked worktree is clean. This is not a GPU validation.

blockers.criterion: Consume the actual D04/formal MANIFEST schema without modifying formal artifacts.
blockers.evidence: Fresh target-host import of V8 then manifest('/data2/_shared/runs/ft_rounds/E2-R067c-d20-short-tail-retry1', MANIFEST.sha256) raised RuntimeError('manifest does not cover all entries'). Real formal manifests list names as ./file and intentionally exclude MANIFEST.sha256, round.json, and round_history governance. V8 compares these rows to every regular file except MANIFEST, including the excluded governance files and normalizes neither ./ prefix. The real history validator itself passed.

blockers.criterion: Consume the canonical D09 retry1 cleanup producer schema.
blockers.evidence: V8 requires exact path D09_T16_RETRY1_OWNED_CLEANUP_READBACK.json with cleanup_ok plus birthbinding. That retry1 file is currently absent while D09 runs. The existing sealed rootwatcher cleanup readback has cleanup_ok, child_absent, launch/status hashes and owners, not birthbinding; V8's own semantics check rejects that producer shape.

blockers.criterion: Round bindings prove T16/D09 candidate, parent/base, and gate/default-off semantics in addition to round ID and verdict.
blockers.evidence: round_binding verifies only canonical round.json path/hash, manifest/history hashes, round_id, and verdict. It never checks T16 experimental candidate=22ff, base=481, D10 default-off gate/source, or D09 candidate=c17b with parent=481. Therefore a canonical but semantically unrelated kept/not_met round can satisfy this source gate.

blockers.criterion: Native admission consumes actual ABI/reuse evidence rather than a self-declared ABI boolean.
blockers.evidence: V8 exact-binds the native-provenance file but accepts native_source_abi_unchanged=true and only checks reuse receipt name/sealed hash. It does not parse reuse receipt fields, verify regular_extensions entries, or compare actual kernel source/reuse file hashes. Independent temporary tests show wrong native path and false ABI field are rejected, but the positive ABI result remains declaration-led in the runtime gate.
